title: Self-Repairing Application System — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public systems knowledge, fact-checked reference. Detects regressions, isolates causes, proposes patches, and verifies fixes before release. When tests fail or behavior drifts, the system bisects the cause, generates candidate patches, and only ships a patch that passes the full suite plus new regression tests.
